live_today.note: robots.txt 404s on every live tenant tested; the response is the career-site SPA's not-found page (text/html), not a plain-text file. Under RFC 9309 this reads as allow-all.

archived.note: Byte-identical template on two tenants across both TLDs, five months apart. Disallow: /xml is the exact path the feed is served on.
archived.payload:
User-agent: *
Disallow: /xml
Disallow: /search
Disallow: /privacy-policy
Disallow: /apply/*
Disallow: /check-applied/*
Disallow: /thank-you/*

step2_api.note: Would have passed comfortably. Recorded because the refusal is about permission, not capability.
notes: createdAt is ISO 8601 with +00:00 offset, present on all 325 — a real posted_at.
seniority is published by the vendor, not inferred from the title as our schema does.
salaryInformation is structured {min,max,currencyCode,currencySymbol,type} but appears on 1 of 325 postings (0.3%).
'Remote' appears as an office name, so it is free text and not a trustworthy workplace enum.

step3_states.note: Cleanly distinguishable, which SmartRecruiters and Cycle-33 Workable could not give.
step3_states.dead: 307 to https://personio.com/ when the redirect is NOT followed
step3_states.trap: Following the redirect returns 429 from personio.com, which a prober would misclassify as blocked rather than dead. Do not follow redirects on this vendor.

revisit_trigger: A Personio tenant serving a robots.txt that PERMITS /xml. The file merely being absent is not the trigger.
